description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Gogo (V))] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Gogo (V))
